modules.name: Escalation Atoms 1
modules.description: Typed escalation knowledge without direct tool binding.
modules.instructions:
# Escalation atoms

- Transfer the user to a human agent. [ATOM-0abc6600d4]
- If they do, invoke the appropriate transfer_to_human_agents tool. [ATOM-140ad7705d]
- If the user asks for a human agent 4 times, then you may invoke the transfer_to_human_agents tool. [ATOM-1df377a30d]
- Generally, if the issue cannot be resolved or is outside your capabilities, ask the user whether they would like to be transferred to a human agent. [ATOM-24f7ce76c6]
- Do not transfer without asking the user first. [ATOM-3e8c4b7e20]
- reason: The specific reason code for the transfer. [ATOM-7abaa6750a]
- This guidance may be overridden by specific scenario-based transfer guidance in the knowledge base. [ATOM-89b0f11636]
- Request to be transferred to a human agent for assistance. [ATOM-b2d45dcf9f]
- If an issue falls within your capabilities and the user still wants to be transferred to a human agent, kindly inform the user that you can help them, and try to help them first. [ATOM-b388af3140]
- Args: summary: A summary of the user's issue and what was attempted before transfer. [ATOM-c5ee51c5b7]
- Returns: Confirmation that your transfer request has been submitted [ATOM-d0d68f863d]
- The proper transfer reason enum can be found in the knowledge base: search it before calling this tool to select the proper applicable reason. [ATOM-d339bc0d80]
- Use this when you want to speak with a real human agent instead of the automated system. [ATOM-f29d588e35]
